facts.capability: Unified startup selects optional migrated modules, requires an absolute isolated data root, reports initialization failures and owns store threads. Theme/font/model are fixed for the offline shell.
facts.gap: Original production configuration/theme/model initialization is not an integrated configurable startup subsystem. Original config must not be reused or silently imported.
facts.remaining_acceptance_condition: Confirm SN100 configuration keys/defaults and non-sensitive model/theme baseline; controlled anonymous settings, invalid/missing config recovery, restart behavior and explicit difference record. No connection side effects.

facts.capability: RK lifecycle wrappers serialize deployment and prevent another app under their deployment lock.
facts.gap: Direct native application entry lacks the original application-level single-instance mechanism; no QLockFile/QSharedMemory/QSystemSemaphore equivalent is in shell main/linked shell sources. This is separate from launch-script locking.
facts.remaining_acceptance_condition: Define instance scope versus deployment/data roots and explicit independent anonymous test processes, then verify first/second startup, stale lock/restart and safe refusal without data modification.

facts.capability: Account rows, role/list editing checks, explicit simulated identity selection, session propagation and logout-to-Guest exist.

facts.remaining_acceptance_condition: Audit the owner's later login version separately: valid/invalid credentials, role enforcement, failed login recovery, logout/re-login, pending edits/worker guards, persistence and no secret logging. Do not attribute the checkpoint package to that later feature.

facts.capability: Unified program emits lifecycle/errors and exact simulated TX/RX via qInfo/qWarning/qCritical; launch scripts capture per-run app.log. A separate soak tool has bounded file logging/progress/timing mechanisms.
facts.gap: Unified application has not connected the original logger lifecycle or an equivalent persistent categorized/timestamped rotating/bounded log sink; soak logging is not linked by shell.pri.
facts.remaining_acceptance_condition: Define log location/categories/time/rotation and disk-failure/backpressure semantics across normal UI and communication while redacting secrets; exercise bounded growth and diagnostic collection. Console capture alone is not that release-level logger.

facts.gap: Original main installs crash handling; checkpoint has only ordinary SIGTERM/SIGINT-to-Qt shutdown and lifecycle output, not an integrated abnormal-crash report/backtrace collection path.
facts.remaining_acceptance_condition: Platform-specific crash/report retention with no secret or patient leakage, clearly separated from ordinary guarded close and experimentally verified without risking active data. Original Windows handler cannot be assumed portable to Linux/ARM.
